topic: Chemical Changes in Materials from Heat
key_concepts: Burning wood is a chemical change called combustion
Combustion releases energy as heat and light
Burning coal releases carbon dioxide and other gases
Solar and wind power are alternative energy sources
Increased temperature can change the properties of materials
Burning waste releases harmful pollutants into air, soil, and water
Pollutants from burning trash can harm plants, animals, and people
Improper waste disposal harms the environment
Reactive materials at home include pesticides, paints, solvents, cleaners, polishes, waxes
Mixing cleaning products can be hazardous
Safety precautions are needed when handling reactive materials
